classification_order: Validate complete non-NUL path/name metadata, lexical canonical spelling and unique names/paths under one shared deterministic rule.
Accept self only at the exact independently pinned executable path; reject a reserved self basename at any other path.

For exact runtime basenames and protected ASCII prefixes ggml/llama/libomp, require the exact mode-eligible pinned runtime name, directory and leased file identity before considering any platform exception.
Accept other DLL reports only with exact declared System32 parent, safe canonical basename and no protected application namespace.
Reject every other report; require exact self and every mode-required core library once.

comparison.canonical_rule: Require absolute DOS-drive spelling, no UNC/device prefix, dot/dotdot/empty components, alternate stream, trailing dot/space or hidden normalization. Do not resolve short-name/Unicode/path aliases.
comparison.case_rule: ASCII A-Z fold only; preserve other UTF16 code units
comparison.name_rule: Snapshot/serialized name must equal reported path basename under the same rule; retain complete reported context.

current_census_scope: Exactly one complete post-core4 current-process snapshot;17 reports, self1/core4/platform12, apphelp sole previously unlisted report
implementation_required: Separately versioned child, data-only parent matcher, contract and protocol with identical policy semantics and policy fingerprint.
Preserve old sources/header/attempts/census unchanged; original16-name classifier remains a historical descriptive baseline.
Regression vectors for protected prefixes/wrong directories, missing/duplicate required modules, outside-platform and malformed/ambiguous paths, and complete17-row observed metadata.
Keep recognition disabled and preserve exact public declarations,25-export owner mapping, typed version/default/layout checks, loader pins and existing cleanup/accounting machinery.
Compile/link only after exact source review; observe ABI only after independent build verification and separate root once-only decision.
selected_route: Prospective pure platform-context rule; no extra platform-image acquisition/pinning/authentication
trust_assumption: The declared Windows host and reported canonical System32 DLL context are trusted platform inputs. This is not image authentication, shim exclusion, initializer attestation, lifetime closure or scientific validation.
